nodes.label: Ask Harsh before drafting answers
nodes.rationale: Brand questions should be sent to Harsh on WhatsApp first to avoid rejected AI-generated drafts.

nodes.label: No hold for missing attachment
nodes.rationale: Script, Invoice, or File emails should not be held for missing attachments as they are added at send time.

nodes.label: Follow-up rhythm
nodes.rationale: Follow up every 3 days until the brand answers; do not stop after a set number of attempts.

nodes.label: No follow-up while owing work
nodes.rationale: Do not send check-ins if the team is currently working on a revised cut or script requested by the brand.
